scripts.dev: npm run build -w sentinela-api && npm run build -w sentinela-test-api && concurrently -k -n api,web,test-api "npm run dev -w sentinela-api" "npm run dev -w sentinela-web" "npm run dev -w sentinela-test-api"
scripts.test: npm run build -w sentinela-api && npm run build -w sentinela-test-api && tsx --test tests/unit.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w sentinela-api && npm run build -w sentinela-test-api && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration.test.ts
